svg.aria-label: A transcoding DAG. Stage 1 splits the original video into video, audio and metadata. Stage 2 runs tasks in parallel: the video is inspected, then encoded into several resolutions, given a thumbnail and watermarked, while the audio is encoded. Stage 3 assembles everything into output files such as clip_360p.mp4, clip_720p.mp4 and clip_1080p.mp4.
svg.title: Video transcoding DAG
